style.font_note: Times New Roman preferred; Nimbus Roman is the installed Times-compatible family, not a claim that proprietary Times New Roman is installed.
style.placement: Include at the stated physical width. Further shrinking reduces text size and requires re-export.
style.scope: All figures generated by the full paper campaign; original raster diagrams require separate font inspection/redrawing.
